root_cause.contradiction_type: Manual Markdown transcription error in AI-QA-FIX-01 report table (NOT an evaluator or JSON summary bug)
root_cause.explanation: In both pre_fix_rag_benchmark_results.json and rag_benchmark_results.json, query EN-06 scored BM25 rank 2 (rank 1 was 'ultrasound-pcom-terminology-guide', rank 2 was 'bangladesh-prescription-terminology'). When CORRECTED_RAG_METRICS.md was manually transcribed during AI-QA-FIX-01, EN-06's BM25 column was mistyped as '1 (1.000)' instead of '2 (0.500)', artificially inflating visible Hits@1 from 16/20 to 17/20 (+1) and visible MRR from (16 + 1/2 + 1/3 + 1/4)/20 = 41/48 = 0.854167 to (17 + 1/3 + 1/4)/20 = 211/240 = 0.879167 (+0.025000 = +0.5/20).
